mapper.select: SELECT room_id AS roomId, created_at AS createdAt FROM room WHERE room_id = #{roomId}

SELECT rm.room_id AS roomId, c.message AS lastMessage, c.sender_id AS lastSenderId, c.chat_at AS lastChatAt FROM room_members rm LEFT JOIN chat c ON c.chat_id = ( SELECT c2.chat_id FROM chat c2 WHERE c2.room_id = rm.room_id ORDER BY c2.chat_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE rm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.chat_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, c.chat_id DESC;
